note: Food (English key, see data/open/aliases.json) -> one source record, picked by hand on 2026-10-19. source: ciqual (Ciqual 2025 alim_code), usda_foundation or usda_sr_legacy (FDC id). state is how the grams are weighed in a recipe. review: a judgment call, listed in data/open/nutrition/review.md. Rebuild with data/build/build_nutrition.py.

basmati rice.note: Thai or basmati rice, raw (dry grams).

beef steak.review: Cut varies by shop. Topside used as the usual lean fillet; rump (6206) is close, rib steak is far fattier.

blueberries.review: Ciqual 'myrtille' covers blueberry and bilberry; cultivated blueberries may be a little sweeter.

canned lentils.review: Ciqual's canned lentils are 'cuisinée' (lightly seasoned); plain jarred lentils are close.

canned mackerel.note: Canned mackerel fillets in brine, drained.
canned mackerel.review: No mackerel in oil record. Mackerel in olive oil, drained, may carry a few g more fat.

canned tuna in oil.note: Whole tuna in sunflower oil, drained.
canned tuna in oil.review: Assumes sunflower oil, the usual cheap pack. Tuna in olive oil is close (Ciqual 26179).

chia seeds.note: Dried chia seed. Carbs exclude fiber (about 34 g).

chicken broth.review: Ready-to-use carton broth assumed; homemade broth can have more fat.

chicken thigh.note: Chicken thigh meat without skin, raw.

chili flakes.note: Cayenne pepper powder, used for dried chili flakes.
chili flakes.review: No chili flake record; cayenne powder is the same dried pepper.

cooked quinoa.note: Quinoa boiled in water, no salt.

cottage cheese.note: Cottage cheese, full fat (about 4%). No cottage cheese in Ciqual.

crushed tomatoes.note: Canned tomato flesh without skin (crushed tomatoes).

cumin.note: Cumin seed (ground cumin is the same food).

dried lentils.note: Dried lentils, average of types (dry grams).

eggs.note: Whole hen egg, raw. Grams come from units by size.

fresh tuna.review: Fresh tuna species varies (yellowfin, albacore/bonito, bluefin). Bluefin has about 6 g more fat per 100 g.

frozen edamame.note: Frozen edamame, unprepared. No edamame in Ciqual.
frozen edamame.review: Shelled beans assumed; edamame in pods weigh more per bean.

frozen mixed berries.note: Frozen raspberries, unsweetened, as a stand-in for a mixed berry pack.
frozen mixed berries.review: No frozen mixed berry record with energy in either source. Mixes heavy in strawberries are about 20 kcal lower per 100 g.

frozen stir-fry vegetables.review: Plain mix assumed. Seasoned stir-fry packs with oil (Ciqual 20273) have about 5 g fat.

grated cheese.review: Grated cheese packs vary (emmental, mozzarella or a mix); emmental used.

greek yogurt.review: European Greek-style yogurt is creamy and low in protein (3 g). Strained Greek yogurt (USDA) has about 9 g; check the label.

greek yogurt 0%.note: Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat. No 0% Greek yogurt in Ciqual.

ground beef.review: Fat in minced beef packs ranges 5 to 20%; 10% used. Ciqual has 5% (6250), 15% (6254) and 20% (6256). Check one Spanish label.

ground chicken.note: Ground chicken, raw. No ground chicken in Ciqual.
ground chicken.review: Ground chicken can include skin and thigh; a breast-only mince is leaner (closer to pechuga de pollo).

ground turkey.note: Ground turkey 93% lean, raw. No ground turkey in Ciqual.
ground turkey.review: Fat in ground turkey packs ranges about 2 to 15%; 93% lean used (this record lists 9.6 g fat). Check one Spanish label.

kalamata olives.review: No kalamata record; generic black olive in brine used.

light cream cheese.note: Plain spreadable fresh cheese, reduced fat.

light fresh cheese.note: Fresh cheese, petit-suisse type, 0% fat, as the closest to a light Burgos.
light fresh cheese.review: Low confidence: no Burgos record. Light Burgos labels range from 0 to about 5% fat; check one.

light mozzarella.note: Part skim mozzarella. No light mozzarella in Ciqual.
light mozzarella.review: Low confidence: USDA part skim is a firm, low moisture cheese. Fresh light mozzarella balls are lower in kcal; check a label.

microwave rice.note: Cooked white rice, no salt (ready-to-heat cups).
microwave rice.review: Cups may be white or brown rice and may contain a little oil. Brown cooked rice is Ciqual 9103.

onion powder.note: Onion powder. Ciqual has dried onion but not the powder.

pork loin.review: Spanish lomo is the lean loin. Ciqual 'échine' (also translated loin) is the fatty neck end and was not used.

pumpkin.review: Spanish calabaza can be pumpkin or butternut; butternut (Ciqual 20138) has about 10 kcal more per 100 g.

quark 0%.note: Fresh cheese, petit-suisse type, 0% fat: closer to the high protein queso fresco batido 0% sold in Spain than plain quark.
quark 0%.review: Plain quark 0% (Ciqual 19644) has about 25% less protein; use it if the pack is plain quark.

ricotta.note: Brousse, a fresh whey cheese like Italian ricotta.
ricotta.review: Brousse is ewe's milk; Italian cow's milk ricotta is close in kcal with a little less protein. Spanish requeson maps to cottage cheese instead (aliases.json), which is closer to its labels.

roasted red peppers.review: No roasted pepper record; jarred roasted peppers are canned red peppers. Ones packed in oil have more fat.

rolled oats.review: USDA used: Ciqual oat flakes (32140) list 10.6 g protein, well under typical labels (13 to 14 g). USDA carbs include about 10 g fiber.

skyr.note: Nonfat strained (Greek) yogurt, used for skyr.
skyr.review: No skyr record in either source. Spanish skyr labels can be lower in kcal and protein than this record; check one label.

smoked paprika.note: Paprika powder; smoking does not change the macros.

spring onion.note: Spring onion or scallion, tops and bulb, raw.
spring onion.review: USDA used: the Ciqual record (11003) mixes chives and spring onion.

textured soy protein.note: Defatted soy flour, used for dry textured soy (dry grams).
textured soy protein.review: No dry textured soy record. Textured soy is extruded defatted soy flour, so macros match; Ciqual has only the rehydrated form (20591).

tomato sauce.review: Closest to Spanish tomate frito; brands vary in oil and sugar.

turkey tenderloin.note: Turkey breast escalope, raw (tenderloin is breast meat).

vanilla whey protein.note: Whey-based protein powder, used for whey protein isolate powder.
vanilla whey protein.review: No plain whey isolate record in Ciqual. USDA 173180 (78 g protein, 6 g carbs per 100 g) is closer to isolate labels than USDA 173177 'Whey protein powder isolate' (58 g protein, 29 g carbs). Flavour and brand change carbs a little; use Open Food Facts by barcode for an exact label.

dropped.frozen salmon: No plain frozen salmon record in Ciqual or USDA, and fresh records are never used for frozen food. Use Open Food Facts by barcode, or add a frozen record.
